The '''Hollan sector''', also known as the '''Hollan D1 sector''', was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Otavon XII]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ovoni]]. It hosted an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supply depot.

After Overlord [[Ghorin]], Supreme governor of the Greater Plooriod Cluster double crossed them, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] took revenge on him by using his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] to destroy the depot.
The aim was to bring shortage to Imperial foodstuff, discredit Ghorin and present him as a traitor to the Empire.

The depot was guarded by the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Sentinel (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Sentinel'']], but the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] ''[[Cathleen]]'' arrived and with the fire from her turbolasers, drove the SD away to facilitate the attack. As a result, a group of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] called ''[[Figii]]'' that were carrying grain were destroyed.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Hollan sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
